hook.en: Two distributions can share the same mean, the same S.D. and perfect symmetry, and still look different: one tall and thin-shouldered, the other flat-topped. *Kurtosis* describes this.
hook.kn: ಎರಡು ವಿತರಣೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಂದೇ ಸರಾಸರಿ, ಒಂದೇ σ, ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಸಮಮಿತಿ ಇದ್ದರೂ ಬೇರೆಯಾಗಿ ಕಾಣಬಹುದು: ಒಂದು ಎತ್ತರ ಚೂಪು, ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಚಪ್ಪಟೆ. ಇದನ್ನು ಶಿಖರತೆ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: Define kurtosis and its three types
Measure kurtosis by β₂ and γ₂

say.en: Two distributions can share the same mean, the same S.D. and perfect symmetry, and still look different: one tall and thin-shouldered, the other flat-topped. Kurtosis describes this. In this lesson: Define kurtosis and its three types.
Measure kurtosis by beta 2 and gamma 2.

body.en: *Kurtosis* is the degree of peakedness (flatness) of a frequency curve compared with the normal curve. It is measured by $\beta_2 = \mu_4/\mu_2^2$ or $\gamma_2 = \beta_2 - 3$. Mesokurtic: $\beta_2 = 3$ (normal). Leptokurtic: $\beta_2 > 3$ (more peaked). Platykurtic: $\beta_2 < 3$ (flatter).
body.kn: ಶಿಖರತೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿದಾಗ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆಯ ಚೂಪುತನ ಅಥವಾ ಚಪ್ಪಟೆತನ. β₂ = μ₄/μ₂², γ₂ = β₂ − 3. β₂ = 3 ಮಧ್ಯಶಿಖರ (ಮೀಸೋಕರ್ಟಿಕ್), β₂ > 3 ಚೂಪು (ಲೆಪ್ಟೋಕರ್ಟಿಕ್), β₂ < 3 ಚಪ್ಪಟೆ (ಪ್ಲ್ಯಾಟಿಕರ್ಟಿಕ್).

say.en: Kurtosis is the degree of peakedness flatness of a frequency curve compared with the normal curve. It is measured by \beta 2 = \mu 4/\mu 2 to the power 2 or \gamma 2 = \beta 2 minus 3. Mesokurtic: \beta 2 equals 3 normal. Leptokurtic: \beta 2 is greater than 3 more peaked. Platykurtic: \beta 2 is less than 3 flatter. Meso: beta 2 equals 3, gamma 2 equals 0.
say.kn: ಶಿಖರತೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿದಾಗ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆಯ ಚೂಪುತನ ಅಥವಾ ಚಪ್ಪಟೆತನ. beta 2 equals micro 4/ micro 2 squared, gamma 2 equals beta 2 minus 3. beta 2 equals 3 ಮಧ್ಯಶಿಖರ (ಮೀಸೋಕರ್ಟಿಕ್), beta 2 is greater than 3 ಚೂಪು (ಲೆಪ್ಟೋಕರ್ಟಿಕ್), beta 2 is less than 3 ಚಪ್ಪಟೆ (ಪ್ಲ್ಯಾಟಿಕರ್ಟಿಕ್).

say.en: Lepto: beta 2 is greater than 3, gamma 2 is greater than 0.
Platy: beta 2 is less than 3, gamma 2 is less than 0.
Start with the normal curve: it is mesokurtic, with beta two equal to three.
A curve with the same variance but a taller, thinner peak and heavier tails is leptokurtic.
A flat-topped curve with short tails is platykurtic.
Measure it with beta two. For mu two equal to four and mu four equal to sixty, beta two is 3.75: leptokurtic.
On the board: Three peaks.

narration.en: Every curve here has mean 0 and variance 1; only the shape parameter p changes. With p = 2 it is the normal curve (β₂ = 3, mesokurtic). Smaller p gives a sharper peak and heavier tails (leptokurtic, β₂ > 3); larger p gives a flat top (platykurtic, β₂ < 3).

problem.en: μ₂ = 4 and μ₄ = 60. Find β₂ and γ₂ and name the curve.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. μ₂ = 4 and μ₄ = 60. Find β₂ and γ₂ and name the curve.

say.en: Let us work this out together. micro 2 equals 4 and micro 4 equals 60. Find beta 2 and gamma 2 and name the curve.
beta 2 equals micro 4/ micro 2 squared equals 60 over 16 equals 3.75.
gamma 2 equals 3.75 minus 3 equals 0.75.
beta 2 is greater than 3.
So the answer is beta 2 equals 3.75, gamma 2 equals 0.75: leptokurtic.

problem.en: For 2, 4, 6, 8 we found μ₂ = 5 and μ₄ = 41. Find β₂.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. For 2, 4, 6, 8 we found μ₂ = 5 and μ₄ = 41. Find β₂.

say.en: Let us work this out together. For 2, 4, 6, 8 we found micro 2 equals 5 and micro 4 equals 41. Find beta 2.
beta 2 equals 41 over 5 squared equals 41 over 25.
beta 2 is less than 3.
So the answer is beta 2 equals 1.64: platykurtic.

body.en: "Lepto" means slender: the peak leaps up. "Platy" means broad, like a plateau or a platypus's flat bill. "Meso" means middle: the normal curve.
